create_ValueStats_feed_values: create a ValueStats object and feed numeric values to track running mean, min, and max
create_ValueStats_summary: create a ValueStats summary string showing average, standard error, min, and max with indices
create_MultiCounter_inc_keys: create a MultiCounter and increment named keys to track event counts over time
create_MultiCounter_summary: create a MultiCounter summary with elapsed time, key counts, and per-key ValueStats statistics
create_MultiCounter_tensorboard: create a MultiCounter with a root directory to log scalar stats to TensorBoard
